title: CFL: Causally Fair Language Models Through Token-level Attribute Controlled Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating unintended bias (over-filtering) due to detoxification by computing Average Treatment Effect (ATE) scores for gender-related tokens and measuring average Language Model (LM) losses per sentence compared to a baseline using prompts from the BOLD dataset.

Evaluating unintended bias by computing ATE scores for race and ethnicity-related tokens (e.g., Black, African, Hispanic) and measuring average LM losses per sentence using prompts from the BOLD dataset.
Evaluating unintended bias by computing ATE scores for religion-related tokens (e.g., Muslim, Hindu) to identify spurious correlations with toxicity and measuring LM performance on related prompts.
